sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
- Can be produced in the Bitcoin farm every 83 hours 20 minutes, when having one Graphics card installed.
- The value of this item is linked to the real world Bitcoin price. This has been confirmed by Nikita, the COO of Battlestate Games on Reddit.
  - The value is refreshed each day at midnight GMT+4.
